methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops in Hampton Roads represent grassroots capability building that could spread peer-to-peer fluency beyond metro concentrations, directly challenging the Pockets of Excellence trajectory if sustained and replicated.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ investment adding 200 AI infrastructure jobs in Henrico deepens Richmond's technical capability but signals capital-intensive concentration—the jobs require specialized skills unlikely to distribute broadly without intentional workforce pathways.

signals.title: NoVA Leaders Debate Data Centers, Metro Funding And The Housing Crisis - patch.com
signals.signal_reading: NoVA leaders debating data centers versus housing reveals infrastructure buildout outpacing human capability development—physical AI infrastructure concentrates without corresponding distributed workforce readiness or equitable access mechanisms.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - WAVY.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk deploying AI for non-emergency call handling demonstrates platform-delivered shallow adoption—capability resides in the vendor's system, not local workforce depth, creating municipal efficiency without building transferable AI skills.

signals.title: Virginia should make AI adoption strengthen the career ladder | Guest column - Richmond Times-Dispatch
signals.signal_reading: Op-ed advocating for AI adoption strengthening career ladders signals awareness that Virginia must choose between shallow platform consumption and deep capability building—the policy fork that determines whether distribution accompanies adoption.
